title: Case 022: A delivered household item is confirmed broken

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The merchant has already reviewed its inline damage-inspection record. The next action is a replacement request to the party authorised to approve it.
initial_request: I would prefer the same lamp rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve a replacement.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Request replacement authorisation from the merchant using the accepted damage evidence.

outcome: The merchant confirms a replacement order and its reference; replacement delivery remains pending.
boundaries: Merchant approval and reserved stock do not establish replacement dispatch or receipt.

events.body: Inline inspection record TG-022: ceramic table lamp arrived with a separated base; recipient report reviewed against our returned-item inspection. Damage accepted for replacement assessment. Dispatch DL-022 has completed; replacement approval is not yet recorded.
I would prefer the same lamp rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve a replacement.
Please approve a like-for-like lamp replacement for TG-022 using your accepted inspection record. Remi has selected replacement in the order thread.
Approved. Replacement order TG-022-R is created for the same lamp at no additional charge. Stock has been reserved; no replacement parcel has been dispatched yet.
